title: Selection of the substate after power on

entities.name: PLMN-SEARCH
entities.description: Initial substate after power on when USIM is available and valid or there are valid entries in the list of subscriber data.

entities.name: NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: Substate entered when no cell can be selected or in manual network selection mode when no cell of selected PLMN/SNPN is found.

entities.name: NO-SUPI
entities.description: Substate entered when no USIM is present, USIM is invalid, or in SNPN mode with no valid subscription identifier.

entities.name: NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: Substate entered when a suitable cell is found and PLMN/SNPN identity is not in forbidden lists and tracking area is not forbidden.

entities.name: LIMITED-SERVICE
entities.description: Substate entered when selected cell is known not to be able to provide normal service.

entities.name: eCALL-INACTIVE
entities.description: Substate entered when UE is configured for eCall only mode.

entities.name: No cell can be selected
entities.description: Condition where UE cannot select any cell.

entities.name: No USIM or invalid USIM
entities.description: Condition where no USIM is present or USIM is considered invalid.

entities.name: SNPN no subscription identifier
entities.description: Condition in SNPN mode where selected entry has no subscription identifier or no valid entry exists.

entities.name: Suitable cell found not forbidden
entities.description: Condition where suitable cell is found and PLMN/SNPN identity and tracking area are not in forbidden lists.

entities.name: Cell cannot provide normal service
entities.description: Condition where selected cell is known not to be able to provide normal service.

entities.name: Manual selection no cell found
entities.description: Condition in manual network selection mode where no cell of selected PLMN/SNPN is found.

entities.name: eCall only mode configured
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for eCall only mode.

entities.name: T3444
entities.description: Timer considered expired at power on for UE configured for eCall only mode.

entities.name: T3445
entities.description: Timer considered expired at power on for UE configured for eCall only mode.

relations.description: Condition of no cell available establishes NO-CELL-AVAILABLE substate.
Condition of no USIM or invalid USIM establishes NO-SUPI substate.
Condition of no subscription identifier in SNPN mode establishes NO-SUPI substate.
Condition of suitable cell found establishes NORMAL-SERVICE substate.
Condition of cell not providing normal service establishes LIMITED-SERVICE substate.
Condition of manual selection with no cell establishes NO-CELL-AVAILABLE substate.
Condition of eCall only mode establishes eCALL-INACTIVE substate.
PLMN-SEARCH state transition is guarded by condition of no cell available.
PLMN-SEARCH state transition is guarded by condition of no USIM or invalid USIM.
PLMN-SEARCH state transition is guarded by condition of no subscription identifier in SNPN mode.
PLMN-SEARCH state transition is guarded by condition of suitable cell found.
PLMN-SEARCH state transition is guarded by condition of cell not providing normal service.
PLMN-SEARCH state transition is guarded by condition of manual selection with no cell.
PLMN-SEARCH state transition is guarded by condition of eCall only mode.
